US Court Dismisses Criminal Charges Against Gautam Adani

A United States judge has dismissed criminal charges, including fraud and bribery allegations, against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani and Sagar Adani. The dismissal was "with prejudice," meaning the case cannot be revived. The charges stemmed from an alleged scheme to pay over $250 million in bribes for solar energy contracts, which Adani consistently denied. Following the dismissal, Rahul Gandhi claimed a "compromised PM" was forced to sell India's interests and that India is paying a huge price.
